items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: The interviewee does not confirm playing with Eddie Dorsey, instead responding with confusion about the name ('do you used to play a piccolo there? What his name? Uh.') and failing to affirm the connection.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And, uh, he had, uh, Leonard, I think, on, on, on Get There. Let's see. And Joe Howard had a trumpet. Oh. And Eddie Atkin on the, on the trombone. And, uh, I was on, uh, clarinet.

Do you remember, did the, was Eddie, uh, Dorsey or Dawson ever in the band there? Eddie Dorsey? Yeah, the bass player, did he ever play with you in that band? Eddie Dorsey. Yeah, or was he at the Entertainers, I believe? Eddie Dorsey.
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Uh, not, uh, what you call it, do you used to play a piccolo there? What his name? Uh.
